value.rationale: The relative spacing of two heterogeneous patches is a natural network design variable absent in the one-hotspot base paper. The uniform lower-flux theorem has a sharp bound: the smallest ring with two distinct two-step destinations exhibits a complete reversal above h=2/5, not merely a small quantitative correction. An exact rational instance flips which arrangement passes the disease-free invasion threshold while holding all other biological parameters constant. The boundary erases the spatial effect of any positive five-patch rate permutation. This is a structurally motivated and potentially useful classification of when hotspot separation helps or harms invasion suppression.
